title: Thread a blister card onto a scan hook's lower wire, under its overhanging price label, beside the stock
instruction: Hang the carded product from the case on the scan hook's lower wire, with the two cards already there.
context: Stockers and order fillers (O*NET 53-7065, 2.8M US workers) stock racks and hooks with merchandise and retail salespersons (41-2031, 3.7M) arrange and display it, all shift. A scan hook's price label overhangs the lower wire's upturned tip, so each card's closed slot is threaded on under it with millimetres to spare. Taking stock off is a lift and a pull; putting it on means finding a shielded tip with a slot.
setup: Positions in cm from the midpoint between the arm bases, x forward, y left; heights above the table. Pegboard: hardboard panel 1.2 cm thick, 34 wide, 32 tall, standing on the table, front face at x 40.5, y -20 to +14, 6 mm holes at 2.5 cm pitch. Scan hook: chromed steel double-wire hook, 8 mm wire, mount plate 3 x 6 cm on the board at y -3. Lower wire: level, axis 20.0 up, from the board to x 22, then a 2 cm upturn rising 4 mm to a round tip at x 20. Upper wire: 4.4 cm above the lower, from the board to x 19.4. Price label plate on its end: white plastic, 5 wide, 3.3 tall, 0.4 thick, front face at x 19, lower edge 2.1 above the lower wire's axis (1.3 over the tip's top), red stripe near its lower edge. Three identical carded fastener packs, 120 g each, loose: card 11 wide, 17 tall (0.6 mm board, built 3 mm thick), yellow with an orange header; hang slot 3.2 wide, 2.0 tall, its centre 1.7 below the top edge (0.7 bridge); blue PET blister 6 wide, 8 tall, 4 deep on the front, 4.5 to 12.5 below the slot centre. Cards A and B hang on the lower wire, blisters toward the robot, faces crossing the wire at x 36.5 and 30.0, resting tilted about 10 degrees, bottoms toward the board. Card C stands in the case on its bottom edge, blister toward the robot, back against the rear wall, face at x 25, centre y -17. Case: cut-down kraft corrugated tray, 3 mm board, inside 4.6 (x) by 13 (y), walls 4 tall, inside x 20.55 to 25.15, centre y -17, taped down; C is its last card.
scoring: From each card's pose. On: the lower wire's axis crosses the card's face inside its 32 x 20 mm slot, card within 20 degrees of upright. Depth: distance along the wire from the tip's centre to the card's face. Released: every finger point 3 cm from C. Still: all three cards under 1 cm/s for 1 s. Whole-run latches: K, card A or B not On for 0.5 s (after the first 1 s) or dropped 3 cm; T, C ever On at depth 10 mm or more. 1.0: C On at depth 30 mm or more (past the upturn), no K, released, still. 0.5: C On at depth under 30 mm, no K, released, still. 0.25: T, then C off the wire at the end, lowest point within 1.5 cm of the table top (on the table or in the case), no K, released, still. 0: K, a card off the table, C held or not still at the end, C never threaded, or nothing done. Tilting the card is allowed. Real table: ruler from tip to C's face; photo of each slot.
reset_notes: Lift card C off the wire and stand it back in the case against the rear wall; re-hang A and B at their marks (tape flags on the wire at x 36.5 and 30.0) if they moved. Nothing is consumed.
fidelity: Approximate. Sizes follow a 20 cm double-wire scan hook and euro-slot card; the wire is 8 mm for a real 5 to 6 mm, so the slot is 32 x 20 mm: 6 mm per side on the level wire, 3 mm over the tip. Rigid bodies: card face 3 mm thick for 0.6 mm board, blister solid. Card bodies carry damping (4/s angular, 1/s linear) for the rub of slot on wire. The sim scores the last step with grippers closed, so a card held, or within 3 cm of a finger, scores 0.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 (Right arm reached over the case beside the hook, never hung the card); demo: 1.0 (Right arm lifted the third card from the case, hung it on the hook, backed away)
